name: Cambodia Championship 2026

information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjI1NTQ4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9cd25a1d4cb3943b6f09957b521e679678c3f3ed/att.hH8Q2bLYTwNv8QTk4JkUzwMroH4pqzfYCaTVgWe6sUI.jpeg)Introducing Cambodia's premier cubing event — the 3rd National Cubing Championship! Join us as we celebrate the passion and skills of our top cubers across the country. 

Stay connected and never miss an update by joining our Facebook group, [CubeArena Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/cambodiacubingcommunity). Be part of the community, get the latest news on upcoming competitions, and watch our cubing scene thrive!

For final round of all events, a maximum of 8 spaces or 50% of spaces (Lower one) will be reserved for competitors representing Cambodia.

For a round with reserved spaces, the competitors advancing from the previous round are a reserved number of best competitors representing Cambodia, followed by the remaining best competitors representing any region.
